title: RootRecoveryTestProduction
description: Result of a custodian's offline recovery test for their single BANZA root key under the 2-of-3 custody model. Public material only: it records whether recovery was tested, when, and whether the PUBLIC key matched after restoring from the encrypted backup. The test is TEST ONLY — NOT PRODUCTION — NO REAL PRIVATE KEYS: it verifies that a backup restores to the correct PUBLIC key without ever exposing private material in any artifact. A missing or failed recovery test yields M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_RECOVERY_TEST_GAP. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

custodian.description: The custodian who performed the recovery test.

key_id.description: The root key id whose backup was recovery-tested (e.g. 'root-key-A').

recovery_tested.description: Whether the custodian performed a recovery test. Must be true or the ceremony is BLOCKED_BY_RECOVERY_TEST_GAP.

tested_at.description: When the recovery test was performed.

public_key_matches_after_restore.description: Whether the PUBLIC key derived after restoring from the encrypted backup matched the originally generated public key.

test_only.description: TEST ONLY — NOT PRODUCTION — NO REAL PRIVATE KEYS. The recovery test never exposes private material in any artifact.
